definition.name: Compare observed prefetched sibling before and after the poll guard

steps.name: Check only the affected diagnostic and source controls
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_dotnet_poll_prefetch tools.tests.test_dotnet_current_aggregate_chain tools.tests.test_dotnet_aggregate_task_wait tools.tests.test_dotnet_managed_work.ManagedWorkContractTests.test_actual_metadata_receipt_requires_every_producer_and_unqualified_scope tools.tests.test_dotnet_managed_work.ManagedWorkContractTests.test_selected_port_binds_exact_new_corelib_and_all_required_facets -v

steps.name: Prepare paired checkouts and the exact native source origin
steps.run:
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-prefetch"
python3 -B -c 'import re; from tools.wasmtime_48_0_8_678b_native_products import SOURCE; assert re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{40}", SOURCE); print(SOURCE)' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-prefetch/native-source.txt"
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 90s git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-prefetch/native-source.txt")"
git worktree add --detach "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-prefetch-baseline" "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)"

steps.name: Install the existing compiler isolation boundary
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap libgdbm6t64 libreadline8t64 libsqlite3-0 liblttng-ust1t64 libtcl8.6 libtk8.6
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Prepare the pinned compiler and unchanged runtime adapters
steps.run:
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' 87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171 "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-prefetch-bindgen"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-prefetch-bindgen:$PATH"
printf '%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-prefetch-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
python3 "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-prefetch-baseline/tools/dotnet_capsule.py" install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-prefetch/tools-baseline" --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"
python3 tools/dotnet_capsule.py install-tools "$RUNNER_TEMP/dotnet-prefetch/tools-fixed" --wasi-sdk "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux"
